SELECT substr(CAST("date" AS VARCHAR),1,4) y, count(*) n, avg("value") a, min("value") mn FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='ICSA' AND substr(CAST("date" AS VARCHAR),1,4) IN ('2019','2026','2022','1969','1968') GROUP BY substr(CAST("date" AS VARCHAR),1,4)
SELECT "date","value" FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='ICSA' AND "value"<=196000 ORDER BY "value","date" FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY
SELECT min("date") mind, count(*) n FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='ICSA'
